summary: Public repository checks cancel obsolete runs only within the same pull request. Public history checks now replace older heads of that PR; main pushes and merge-group runs retain independent run groups. Required check names and scanner permissions are unchanged.

replay.detail: No runtime replay or stored data changes.

schema.detail: No database, wire or checkpoint schema changes.

rules.detail: Required checks and repository protection are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: New public-check runs cancel in-progress work only for pull_request events. Each other event uses its own run identity, preserving pending and active main or merge-group proofs.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or runtime deployment is required.

manual.detail: No manual action is required; the concurrency policy applies to newly created workflow runs.

recovery.detail: Existing run evidence is retained; no data recovery is required.
